name: guild
description: The server a session's place is in, from the transport.

name: channel
description: The place a session lives in, from the transport. A channel's parent is its guild.

name: thread
description: The thread a session lives in, from the harness's own thread records (read at compile from R6). A thread's parent is its channel.

name: project
description: The project a session works in, from the harness's own project records (read at compile from R6).

name: person
description: The people a session involves: given by the transport (a DM's user, read from the place), and stored beside it, declared by the operator or by the import from an imported session's authors and places. A person carries its handles.

name: topic
description: What a session is about, declared by the operator, or by the import from an imported session's labels. Topics nest.

name: event
description: A dated happening (a release, an outage, a meeting, a deadline); the date is mined in code, never Jev's.

name: resource
description: A repository, service, host, document or dataset the session works with.

name: capability
description: A tool, skill or extension the session needed.

name: expertise
description: The domain the session draws on.

name: culture
description: How things are done here, learned from corrections over time.
